story.title: Every detail has a feeling.
paragraphs: We believe the most beautiful celebrations are the ones that feel unmistakably yours. We bring together thoughtful design, expressive florals and considered details to create spaces your family will remember long after the last song.
Rooted in Kanpur and inspired by the richness of Indian celebrations, our team balances timeless ceremony with fresh, contemporary styling.
